sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Estevao Willian made his first Premier League start of the season in Chelsea's 2-0 victory against Manchester United. He had two goals disallowed and received a standing ovation. Morgan Rogers scored a solo goal in the second half, and Cole Palmer sealed the win from the penalty spot.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Chelsea faced a shortage of options with eight players missing, including first-choice striker Joao Pedro. The impressive performances of Estevao and Rogers eased pressure on head coach Xabi Alonso after recent defeats and proved the team can find creative attacking solutions.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Estevao's standout display will increase pressure on Xabi Alonso to keep the winger in the starting lineup for upcoming matches.
